desc: Read N and the sorted array A from stdin.
Initialize two pointers: i = 0 (top candidates from the smallest half) and j = N/2 (bottom candidates from the larger half), with count = 0.
While i < N/2 and j < N: if 2*A[i] <= A[j], increment count, i, and j; otherwise increment only j.
Output count as the maximum K.
Verify edge cases: N=2 with valid/invalid pair, all equal elements (answer 0), and N odd (only floor(N/2) tops considered).

Implement and output the final Python solve() that reads N and A from stdin, runs the two-pointer greedy matching the N//2 smallest mochi as tops against the larger half as bottoms (count a pair and advance both pointers when 2*A[i] <= A[j], else advance only the bottom pointer), and prints the count.
